usage: 半斤 refers to a specific measurement of weight commonly used in Hong Kong and southern China, equal to half a catty.
It is used as a noun to indicate quantity when buying food or goods in markets.
You place 半斤 before the item name to specify how much you want, e.g., 半斤蘋果 (half catty of apples).
It can be used in daily conversation when discussing weights or prices.
The measurement 半斤 is informal and mainly used in spoken Cantonese or casual settings.
